verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API client and testing tool (request building, collections, CLI test runs, an MCP server that exposes workspace data). Governing live LLM/MCP traffic with token limits, prompt guards and provider routing is an AI-gateway or proxy role outside that category. Nothing in the evidence shows it shipping gateway-style traffic governance; its MCP server and request interceptor are adjacent features, not this capability.
